note: Majority: not read. The Civil Code of Seychelles Act 2020 was sought; SeyLII's site now carries only its judgment collections (the old legislation pages are gone), the Government Gazette site (gazette.sc) refused this client (403), the National Assembly's site answered 500, and archive.org's snapshot of SeyLII's Employment Act page (2022) couldn't be fetched (connections reset); null. Work: Employment (Conditions of Employment) Regulations 1991 (S.I. 34 of 1991, under the Employment Act, Cap. 69, 2010 edition), as the Ministry of Employment publishes them (a scanned print, read by eye, as its text layer is a poor OCR): regulation 21 (as amended by S.I. 3/2000): no one may have in their employ a person under fifteen; regulation 22(1): no one under eighteen in a hotel, guest-house, tourist accommodation, restaurant, shop, bar, nightclub, dance-hall, discotheque or similar place of entertainment, or on a ship or aircraft, save under a training scheme the Minister approves; (2) none under eighteen between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.; (3) none under twenty-one in a gaming-house or casino; (4) the competent officer may exceptionally grant special written permission for those aged fifteen to seventeen in those places or hours. Performers: regulation 21 names no exception for performing, so barred under fifteen (my reading); the permission of 22(4) is for fifteen to seventeen and isn't held. Amendments after the 2010 edition (S.I. 26 of 2015, 32 of 2018, 34 of 2019, listed on the same page) weren't read. Service: no defence law was read; null.

sources.title: Ministry of Employment (Seychelles): Employment (Conditions of Employment) Regulations 1991, S.I. 34 of 1991 (Employment Act, Cap. 69, 2010 edition, subsidiary)
sources.said: A person shall not have in that person's employ another of less than 15 years of age. ... A person shall not employ another under the age of 18 years in a hotel, guest-house, boarding house, any place where tourists are accommodated, restaurant, shop, bar, nightclub, dance-hall, discotheque or similar place of entertainment or on a ship or aircraft.
